job.description: The real N13 run: the three new arms (n80-rw, n80-mix-rep, n80-w02) on N12's five seeds (4101-4105), 15 training runs, plus re-measurement of N12's 15 saved models (n80, n80-mix, sub20, read from the n12_bottleneck Drive folder) and 15 cross-model comparisons, measured on the held-out tail's windows 1-512. Calibration done (seed 3001: replicate floor 0, no amendment). NEEDS AN A100: before Run all, choose Runtime > Change runtime type > A100 GPU. On any other GPU it stops before training. About 40 minutes. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
